nodes.norm_label: smart video processing with intelligent caching

nodes.label: Smart Codec Detection (stream copy vs re-encode)
nodes.norm_label: smart codec detection (stream copy vs re-encode)
nodes.rationale: Analyses codec/resolution/framerate per clip: identical codecs use fast stream copy (instant preview), mixed codecs force full re-encode with a compatibility warning. Prevents merge failures and wasted processing. Course docs market this as 'AI-assisted video processing' though it is rule-based ffprobe analysis.
